description:
Anime adaptation of Part 3 of Honzuki no Gekokujou.

Following a disastrous encounter with a noble, Myne finally resolves to say goodbye to her family and friends in the lower city, changing her name to “Rozemyne” and beginning her new life as the adopted daughter of Ehrenfest’s archduke. However, her days as an archnoble in noble society are brutal, as she is put through rigorous etiquette and magic training on top of her duties as High Bishop and forewoman. It all proves too much for a weak little seven-year-old girl... Or it would have, had the High Priest not offered her the keys to the temple’s book room as a reward. If she could get her hands on those, she’d be able to read all sorts of precious books! Her name may have changed, but Rozemyne’s passion for books remains the same as she charges into a whole new world! The detailed setting expands as the printing industry grows in size. Here begins Part 3 of this biblio-fantasy for book lovers everywhere!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

description:
The novel takes place in the summer of 1907, the 40th year of the Meiji era. 15-year-old Inako Momokawa lives in the Fushimi area of Kyoto, and is the second daughter of a sake brewer. Nothing she does ever comes out right, and she receives a scolding from her father every day. Her only relief is the trust she places in her prayers to the gods. One day while at Fushimi Inari shrine, she meets a freewheeling young man named Kihachi Sakamoto. He rejects the gods, and boasts of the incoming age of electricity.

The topic of marriage suddenly comes up in Inako's household. Her father is one-sidedly making all the decisions for her, and Inako is about to give up hope. It is then that Kihachi draws out Inako's true feelings of wanting to run away from her family. The only way to stop her marriage is to find an unusual book called the "Electricity Catalog." The book is a prediction book about electricity that Kihachi wrote when he was a child, but his older brother Seiroku took the book, and its current whereabouts are unknown. Inako and Kihachi together go in search of the book across Kyoto and Shiga prefectures.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ヒトリ妻

description:
Here we go again… Yukina had come to visit her husband, who’d been injured at work, but she was dumbfounded to see him striking up conversations with every woman in sight. She ignored him and sat down on a bench in the hallway. Then, a cup of coffee was handed to her. It was from Yuto, a young man visiting his girlfriend—whom he’d met recently—and who was doting on her with a friendly, refreshing charm. For Yukina, who couldn’t help but compare him to her husband, it was just a distraction—perfect for simply watching—and she was supposed to be savoring that moment…

After seeing a flyer for a part-time job at a newly opened café, she rushed in. Standing across from her at the counter was Yuto, the man she’d met at the hospital. She was hired on the spot, and at the newly opened shop, it was just her and Yuto, the owner… For this married woman, who had devoted herself entirely to her husband, this new encounter marked the beginning of a daily life steeped in transgression—lewd, maddening, and utterly intoxicating…

(Source: Getchu, translated)

According to the village chief, the island's Guardian Deity foresaw the arrival of you and your friends, and they want you to help the island return to its former glory. Without more tourists, there aren't enough people to worship the Guardian Deity, whose powers you need to return to your home world. Work together with your friends, Sahoto, Mei, and Chiyo, as well as some new friends you make on the island, to help it grow and prosper into a popular tourist destination!

But one day, Makoto finds out Mano's secret, and with an angelic smile, she starts making devilish demands! Mano seduces him with various types of play. However, in order to melt away Makoto's hesitation, she provokes him into serving her...!? A pure love story of a devilish angel!

Kaede, a beautiful young lady with excellent grades, has absolutely no knowledge of sex. Having been raised to stay away from sexual activity until marriage, she reacts by… begging Akito—who’s rumored to be quite the pervert—to teach her about sex! After voraciously absorbing Akito’s eccentric knowledge of video games and anime, the young lady becomes completely hooked on lewd acts, and her sexual demands keep escalating…!?

Karen, the object of admiration for the judo club members, had always been uncomfortable around Tooru—the only man who had ever defeated her. Ever since that loss, just catching a whiff of Tooru’s scent sent a wave of pleasure coursing through her entire body. Earth has entered an era of intergalatic exchange.
Amidst swirling prejudice and fear of aliens, Elie, an alien girl, arrives as a space goodwill ambassador. She loves Earth's culture and its often absurd daily life, and has teamed up with a civil servant working at the space agency to search for "friends".

GALs TOKYO, a city where morning never comes.
Night after night, girls who have lost their place in reality, known as "Gal P", gather here. Their goal is to become the winner, the "Queen" in a game called "Queen of Butterfly" or "QoB" for short.

Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～):
A world after humanity has perished.
Traveling in a van are Ayame, a pure-blooded vampire, and three girls who survived by being bitten and "infected" by her. There, they find a sky full of stars that illuminate the night as brightly as day, and fields of glittering golden grass—even a desolate world looks so beautiful through the eyes of a vampire.
They enjoy a simple everyday life in this world left behind.

description:
Based on the erotic game by Studio Pork.

Sunao Saiki, who had just moved into an apartment, was a student preparing for college entrance exams. He began his new life living alone with a somber expression. However, after meeting the wife of the couple next door and being captivated by her beauty, Sunao’s new life began to brighten up. “I’m Ayano Shinonome, your neighbor. Nice to meet you.” By chance, Sunao ended up working at the same part-time job as Ayano. As Ayano kindly looked out for him both at work and in the apartment, Sunao gradually found himself drawn to her. But she was a married woman. Sunao tried to hold back, yet his feelings were impossible to suppress, and he spent his days torn by inner conflict. At the same time, Ayano, too, began to see the likeness of her first love in Sunao and started to view him as a man… The memory of a first love, the warmth of a married woman. Separated by just a single wall, a dangerous romance begins to blossom.

(Source: Getchu, translated)
